test_title: PYST 32: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X, and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing the north. Only two people sit to the right of X. Only two people sit between X and C. Only two people sit between A and D. D sits to the immediate left of X. B sits to the immediate right of Y.

Who sits at the third position from the left end of the line?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, W, X, and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing the north.

1. Only two people sit to the right of X.

2. Only two people sit between X and C.

3. D sits to the immediate left of X.

4. Only two people sit between A and D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db5c4439bbd59a4e5faa17fc5ad92904bd368e07ba674359d7567086b08c07d6.png] 

5. B sits to the immediate right of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0769c66ae0d03291b3677b0c10861fd63d378810b9de5f6aeea29467b4dc271a.png] 

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case II, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73549f1ab7107e3958cf4af6050a578172faa34556eac7c8dfbd96b5fef78a08.png] 

Thus, W sits at the third position from the left end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
